title: AgentCapabilityReceipt.v1
description: Mandatory PROVENANCE of one capability run on the Teleon Agent Capability Gateway: which capability ran for which consumer, the input/output content hashes (so the result is tamper-evident and de-duplicable), the runtime_path actually taken on the token-saving ladder (deterministic|cache|api|llm_fallback|human — the cheapest step that served it, proving deterministic-first), the backend it executed on, a cost_estimate, start/complete timestamps, and the policy_checks that were enforced. The receipt records WHAT WAS DONE and HOW CHEAPLY; it never asserts the output is true (Baltor governs truth). No raw secrets — hashes, runtime_path labels, and check booleans only.

request_id.description: the run request this receipt attests

consumer_id.description: the agent consumer the run was executed for

input_hash.description: canonical hash of the run input (tamper-evident; not the raw input)

output_hash.description: canonical hash of the output (tamper-evident; not the raw output)

runtime_path.description: the token-ladder step actually used to serve this run — deterministic/cache/api are the cheap hot path; llm_fallback/human only when the deterministic ladder was exhausted and policy allowed; recording it proves the gateway is deterministic-first

backend.description: the execution backend the run ran on (e.g. local_function@v1; cloud/K8s by policy via the execution backend selector)

cost_estimate.description: estimated cost of this run (e.g. {unit: 'usd', amount}); the basis for cost-per-successful-run pricing

policy_checks.description: the governance checks enforced, e.g. {capability_allowed, no_forbidden_tool_used, secrets_refs_only, deterministic_first_honored, llm_fallback_within_policy, cost_within_max, freshness_met, no_self_boundary_expansion} -> booleans
